environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, JDK 17, with imgconvert native binary (compiled without stack canaries or ASLR, using -fno-stack-protector -z execstack). Application runs as ec2-user with read access to /etc/shadow, AWS instance metadata available at 169.254.169.254, IMDSv1 enabled. No input length validation on width/height/fields parameters before passing to native binary.
